meta.title: Racing code
meta.description: Per-project development flows, declared in the project's own docs/racing-code.md as a mermaid diagram: stages run in order, parallel lanes race several models in separate git worktrees, and a CR review feeds each lane its own problems until every lane passes. Projects without that file are not enabled. A first-run bootstrap for new projects generates that file on explicit request: confirm the flow first, then pick each node's model from the whole DSH llm catalog — a model outside the subagent allowlist is appended to it (effective in the next session).
